No workflow changes are included.\\n\\nThe source commits are `d2b853b6…` (oracle integration) and `2b6e9ebf…` (V18 synchronization), followed by review `ca10314f…` and bound head **`4786c1457b47c5baf4c09d32b96048795e863111`**, tree `6518a5b317683a24ded3a69b027da6a04b8c996c`.\\n\\n## Validation and evidence\\n\\nThe [independent source review](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/ca10314fbc5a4ffa28ada5b7c1097c1091b48aa4/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-borrowed-oracle-main-integration-bfcc-20261009/independent-source-review.json) accepts this exact composition. No workflow changes are included.\\n\\nThe source commits are `d2b853b6…` (oracle integration) and `2b6e9ebf…` (V18 synchronization), followed by review `ca10314f…` and bound head **`4786c1457b47c5baf4c09d32b96048795e863111`**, tree `6518a5b317683a24ded3a69b027da6a04b8c996c`.\\n\\n## Validation and evidence\\n\\nThe [independent source review](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/ca10314fbc5a4ffa28ada5b7c1097c1091b48aa4/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-borrowed-oracle-main-integration-bfcc-20261009/independent-source-review.json) accepts this exact composition.
